title: Terminal host: PTY + alacritty screen copy + allow-listed replies (no routes)
what:
src/term/mod.rs, Terms (State for ctx.term):
- ids t<n>; at most 16 terminals including exited ones (an exited terminal is kept 30 min or until closed)
- each terminal holds: PTY master; child (pid = pgid = sid); Mutex<alacritty Term> with scrolling_history 2000 and OSC 52 disabled; raw ring 512 KiB with seq = byte offset; owner {by: operator|agent, chat?}; agent_last_ms; hold; title; fg (comm of tcgetpgrp); cols/rows; last_ms; exit
pty.rs:
- spawn: openpty + spawn_command run as a job on the existing Spawner thread (spawn.rs gains a generic job kind), so terminal forks never interleave with door forks
- program: CommandBuilder::new_default_prog() (login shell)
- cwd: the given one, which the caller checked, else HOME
- env: the perch's own plus TERM=xterm-256color, COLORTERM=truecolor, LANG=C.UTF-8 when unset, MINERVA_TERM=<id>; never a token
- reader: one std thread per terminal: Term.advance -> ring -> notify; above ~8 MiB/s it sleeps 10 ms per slice
- writer: one thread per terminal with a bounded 64 KiB queue
- exit: spawn_blocking(child.wait)
- close: killpg(sid, SIGHUP) and SIGHUP to tcgetpgrp; drop the master; wait 2 s; sweep /proc/*/stat for session == sid and SIGKILL each; reap
- shutdown(ctx): the same for every terminal concurrently, bounded at 2.5 s
The perch is the only answerer, through one function, reply_kind(event) -> Option<bytes>, that every alacritty event passes:
- Event::PtyWrite (alacritty's own answers: DA, DSR/CPR, DECRQM, keyboard mode, CSI 18t text-area size in chars) goes to the writer.
- ColorRequest (OSC 4/10/11/12) is answered from the default theme's palette, fixed in the perch.
- TextAreaSizeRequest (pixels, CSI 14t) is declined, because the perch knows no pixel size.
- ClipboardLoad and ClipboardStore are always refused.
- Anything else is dropped.
- XTVERSION and DECRQSS go unanswered: alacritty does not answer them and the page swallows them, so an app that asks waits out its own timeout. Documented in the README.
screen.rs:
- text(lines ≤ 400, max_chars ≤ 7000) -> {text, cursor, alt_screen, seq}; title; resize (cols 20-400, rows 5-200) on both PTY and Term
terms.json (statefile pattern, 0600):
- each ended terminal's last screen text (≤ 64 KiB), so the page and term_read can say 'ended when the perch stopped' (D3)
tests:
In-crate unit tests with a real /bin/sh:
- spawn, write 'echo hi' + CR, and text() contains hi within 2 s
- resize changes the Term's columns
- a `sleep 1000 &` child is gone from /proc after close
- `printf` of a DSR query gets exactly one reply on the shell's stdin
- reply allow-list: an OSC 52 read, a CSI 14t and an XTVERSION produce no write; an OSC 11 query gets exactly one palette answer; a unit test over reply_kind() covers every Event variant
- the 17th spawn is refused
- the child env has MINERVA_TERM and no master-token value
- shutdown() ends every shell within 2.5 s
- terms.json is 0600 and keeps the last screen
live_check: No routes yet; `cargo test` in WSL.
risk:
- portable-pty sets FD_CLOEXEC non-atomically (unix.rs:63-65). The Spawner thread narrows the window and the sweep covers it.
- A process that calls setsid itself escapes the sweep; this is documented.
- Terminals end with the perch; no holder process.
- Colour queries see the default theme, not the page's current one.
